svg.title: OpenZeppelin confidential-token port benchmark
svg.desc: Alternating source builds on an Apple M3 Max and circuit K and rows paired by entrypoint name. The Noctium development build includes uncommitted compiler changes and generated zero SDK bindings. Timings exclude key generation and proving.

g.text: SOURCE BUILDS · MEDIAN OF THREE ALTERNATING RUNS PER COMPILER
Ledger and witness outputs · range deduplication on
Timings cover different compiler outputs. Both exclude key generation and proving.
Δ = Noctium rows minus Compact rows. Percentage uses Compact as the baseline.
Pairs share entrypoint names. The ports have different ABIs and state paths.
Both sets use the same ZKIR 3.2.1 sizing tool. Proving latency was outside this benchmark.
Noctium development snapshot (base cedb6ef) · OpenZeppelin f85f1a2
